headline: Approved Block and Leviton contract and portfolio changes moving $5.6 from Russell Top 200; also approved April 16, 2026 minutes.
summary: Members reviewed the 2026 second quarter performance report, which showed a gain of $11,899 so far. They unanimously accepted the Block and Leviton contract. They also approved moving $5.6 from Russell Top 200, with $2.5 to Smith Affiliated, $2.0 to Carlyle Private Equity, and the rest to cash.
decisions: Approved the April 16, 2026 minutes, with a reminder to send City Contributions information by 9/1/2026, by unanimous vote.
Accepted the Block and Leviton proposal/contract by unanimous vote.
Approved moving $5.6 from Russell Top 200, with $2.5 to Smith Affiliated, $2.0 to Carlyle Private Equity, and the rest to cash, by unanimous vote.

DONALD R. GREBIEN        JEANNINE BOURSKI
           MAYOR              ACTING FINANCE  DIRECTOR
City of Pawtucket Pension Board Minutes
Date/Time:  Thursday, August 6, 2026, 4:15 pm, City Hall Annex, Room 204, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI
Opening/Call to Order - Jeannine Bourski called the meeting to order at 4:15 pm.
Roll Call
Members Present – Cory Morel, Andrew Torres, Michael Kane, Steve Parent, John Wallace, Mark Wildenhain,
and Jeannine Bourski
Others Present – Peter Kilmartin representing Block & Leviton, and, Managing Director Devin Condron
representing Graystone Consulting.
Public Comment - It was noted there were no requests to speak during the public comment period.
Approval of Minutes
Motion:  Motion to approve with reminder to send the information requested last time on the City
Contributions to be sent out by 9/1/2026 by Michael Kane, seconded by John Wallace to approve the April 16,
2026 minutes.
In Favor:   All
Opposed:   None
Motion carried by unanimous vote.
Old Business
Vote on the Block and Leviton proposal/contract
Discussion / vote on the Block and Leviton proprosal/contract –
Motion: To accept the contract by John Wallace, seconded by Steve Parent
In Favor:   All
Opposed:   None
Motion carried by unanimous vote.
CITY  OF  PAWTUCKET
CITY HALL
137 ROOSEVELT AVENUE
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND  02860
________________
OFFICE OF THE FINANCE DIRECTOR
2
New Business
Review of 2026 Second Quarter Performance  –
Devon went over the report.  Good first half of the year.  Second quarter was all about a rebound.  Interest
rates are trending up and this may be problematic for Equities.  We are now forecasting almost 30% earnings
which is pretty high.  Markets are broadening out currently.  S & P is up high around 10% and the rest of the
world is higher.  Info Tech and Energy are driving the US at this time due to 4 major companies.  AI is a big
piece of this.  Energy is mostly due to what’s going on with Iran and spiking of oil.  Top 10 weighted top S & P
constituents are mostly tech driven now.
Retail Sales and Bank Loans are really healthy right now.  The low end consumer is feeling the hit right now.
People are spending their savings to get by right now.  The thing to watch in the second half of the year is the
price of oil.  This will drive a lot in the markets.  We expect to see some more volatility going forward.  There
were no questions on the markets.  
Gain so far is $11,899.  The current quarter is up around 9%.   We went through all of the managers
individually.  Morgan Stanley is reassessing the hedge funds top managers and will report back at the next
meeting.  We are going to exit AMG since they are not doing well.   
Additional discussion / proposal regarding portfolio manager changes –
Devon recommends we move $5.6 from Russell Top 200.  We would move $2.5 to Smith Affiliated and also
$2.0 into Carlyle Private Equity.  The rest would go to cash.
Motion:  Accept offer above in bold by John Wallace, seconded by Mike Kane.
In Favor:  All
Opposed:  None
Motion carried by unanimous vote.
Correspondence – None
Adjournment – There being no other business, motion by John Wallace, seconded by Mike Kane to adjourn.
The motion was carried by unanimous vote.  The meeting stood adjourned at 5:09pm.
Prepared by:
Jeannine Bourski
Acting Director of Finance
